title: UploadGate permit release/re-acquire race panics in request path

recommended_fix: acquire_permit returns the permit; move it into the lease; delete take_permit

title: Declared-size gRPC uploads double-charged against byte budget
impact: Every declared upload > budget/2 aborts mid-stream; smaller ones double-consume and starve others
recommended_fix: charge only unknown-size leases; known leases reserve once; gate test with expected>budget/2

title: Boot sweep non-recursive - shard-dir .tmp-* and .gc-pending never cleaned
impact: Crash loops leak full-size blob copies forever; M-06 and W1-C-03 boot-recovery claims ineffective
recommended_fix: recursive walk to shard_depth+1 reusing list_all's walker; add boot_sweeps_stale_tmp gate

title: Replication lag observability dead: acked() has zero call sites; dropped ops counted into lag
impact: replication_lag_ops never published; queue_depth() monotonic; ops alerting impossible
recommended_fix: pass Arc<AtomicU64> into worker_loop; call acked(n) after each flush; decrement on drop

title: c01-boot-gate CI job can never pass (pipe exit code + grep word)
impact: C-01 live-enforcement claim unsupported; gate permanently red or silently ignored
recommended_fix: set -o pipefail / capture without pipe; grep 'invalid configuration|jwt_secret'; add workflow self-liveness check

title: nightly job unreachable (no schedule trigger); H-01 memory gate runs nowhere

recommended_fix: add schedule cron; move h01_upload_memory_bound to a reachable job; add permissions: block

title: Residual sub-txn window: GC claim+delete between upload blob-check and commit
impact: Live row + deleted blob (dangling); detected as phantom; unrepaired on primary
recommended_fix: post-commit path_exists re-assert + one rewrite in store_chunk while bytes in scope

title: Reconcile materializes all manifests and refcount>0 rows despite batched doc

recommended_fix: optional micro-batch group-register; fold into P2 group-commit

impact: Budget bypass via chunked transfer (concurrency cap only)
recommended_fix: charge in the raw-body stream adapter; never charge known-size leases

title: Quarantine store full-dir scan+sort per hostile chunk
impact: Hostile upstream sustains O(n) metadata churn per event (bounded disk CPU/IO amplifier)
